page.layout: One diagram block (dichotomy with braces) on the left part of the page: labels A and B in the left margin, boxes to the right of the braces. A horizontal rule separates the upper branch A from the lower branch B. No running head, page number, catchword or signature visible.; One page of text, set as a tree diagram with braces, in one column. Top: Immobile and Mobile under a brace, with the eight spheres beside Mobile. Middle: Congregata and Sola, each with its own list beside a brace. Lower: Qualitates with Activa and Passiva, Species with Leve and Grave, and four elements. Below the diagram: a line of running text and the signature C.

main_text.l: B. Mutabile corpus inde est aut
Species: Ita elementa est, tum aliud est.

page.notes: The "vel" after "A." is followed by a stray mark that may be a printing blemish. "inde" is read from "iude" and is doubtful, so it is marked [?] in the transcription. "obj[?]" is doubtful. The lower label reads "corpus" with a smudge over the "p". The first line of the lower box is partly set in italic, which is kept as printed. The image shows faint show-through at the top, which is not transcribed. Several words in the diagram are cut at the left and right edges (e.g. "dictum", "Suntque", "magnitudine"), and the opening of the last line is cut, so it reads only "fitum". Individual box labels are partly cramped by the braces and the reading of "Species" and "Ita elementa" is uncertain; the bracket wording is reconstructed from the box layout. The level of Qualitates and Species is read from the braces.
